data_fields.name: coin_offer_max
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: min(offer, cash on hand), refused if below 0

data_fields.name: receiver_slot_check
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: current size + incoming >= volume limit refuses (limit value not read)

data_fields.name: droid_trade_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: droids in datapad + droids in trade >= getBaseStoredDroids (value not read)

best_idea: A trade is two confirms on one shared, locked offer; any edit clears both, and one settle() writes all rows under one group id or none.
decision_why: Mutual request, fail-closed re-check, no-trade flags and one ledger group per trade fit our one-ledger rule; the donor's unused accept flag, unclear-on-edit confirms and item-by-item settle are defects we fix in origins/server/trade.ts.
acceptance: Two players within 15 units; A offers a gear piece and 500 coins; B confirms; A changes coins to 5 and both confirms clear; after both confirm again, one settle() writes one item row and one coins row under one trade id; a server test asserts that an edit after one confirm settles nothing and that one failing row aborts the whole trade.
